newsitem.title: UK: Telewest in early talks with NTL-report.
newsitem.headline: Telewest in early talks with NTL-report.

text.p: Telewest Communications Plc is in tentative talks with U.S. cable company NTL, said an unsourced report in The Independent on Monday.

The report said NTL was trying to kickstart further consolidation in the UK cable industry. The Independent said industry sources claimed NTL wanted to create a rival to Cable & Wireless Communications Plc.
This latest speculative report follows recent market rumours that Telewest and Cable and Wireless were in merger talks.
But Telewest issued a statement last week saying its operational review was not finalised and the company was "not in a position to comment in detail on recent press speculation."
